title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Frontal picture of the native bumblebee Bombus dahlbomii (the largest bumblebee in the world) obtained through stack-photography (Credit: Manuel López-Aliste)

This month's cover image is provided by the authors of López-Aliste et al. (2026), which features in this issue:

‘Differential effects of agricultural expansion on wild bee taxonomic and functional diversity’ (https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2435.70294)

The authors assessed how natural area proportion affects wild bee taxonomic and functional diversity in apple and sweet cherry orchards in central Chile, finding that both taxonomic and functional diversity matter for effective pollination. These results demonstrate the importance of considering both factors when developing strategies to balance agricultural production with biodiversity protection.
